name: Plaza de Armas / Centro Historico
description: The historic core around the Plaza de Armas is where most visitors and remote workers base themselves, lined with whitewashed, red-tile-roofed colonial houses, the cathedral, and the town's best cafes and guesthouses. Everything, the market, tour agencies, ATMs, and restaurants, is a short walk away, making it the most practical and pleasant base in town.
bestFor: first-time visitors and remote workers wanting everything walkable
cons: Can feel touristy near peak season

name: Mirador / Airport Area (Shocol)
tagline: Quiet edge of town near the airstrip and viewpoints
description: The area around Chachapoyas' small Shocol airport and the hillside miradores on the town's edge offers a quieter, more residential feel with sweeping views over the valley. It suits longer-stay visitors who want space and calm over proximity to the plaza, with a short mototaxi ride connecting back to the center for shopping and meals.
bestFor: longer stays seeking quiet and views over convenience
pros: Easy access if flying in or out

name: Mercado Central District
tagline: The working market district, cheap eats and daily life
description: Just a few blocks from the plaza, the streets around the Mercado Central are where locals do their daily shopping for produce, meat, and household goods, and where the cheapest comedores and juice stalls operate. It's a lively, unpolished slice of everyday Chachapoyas life, good for budget-conscious stays close to fresh food and colectivo connections.
bestFor: budget travelers who want cheap food and an authentic daily rhythm

name: Nuevo Tingo (Kuelap Gateway)
tagline: The village base for the Kuelap cable car
description: Roughly an hour from Chachapoyas by combi or tour van, Nuevo Tingo is the small village that hosts the teleferico cable car station up to the Kuelap fortress. A handful of simple guesthouses and eateries here let travelers base closer to Kuelap, avoid early departures from town, or break up the region's longer sightseeing loops overnight.
bestFor: travelers prioritizing early or unhurried Kuelap visits
pros: Minutes from the Kuelap cable car
cons: Very limited dining and shopping options
